gate_reasoning: Stage 3 has a structurally strong primary-filing core for vendor financials (Samsara 10-K, Motive S-1, Karooooo 6-K, EROAD NZX, Full Truck Alliance 20-F, NHTSA FARS, WHO, BPS Indonesia, FMCSA, ATRI, CVSA primary) that makes the audit trail on the most load-bearing claims (vendor revenues, regulatory context, road safety statistics) auditable and sound. However, three material issues block full 'ship-as-is': (1) Factual discrepancies: the combined ratio figure (113 vs. confirmed ~108.5) and the per-mile insurance cost ($0.102 vs. confirmed ~$0.087 in ATRI summaries) are cited as precise PP3.2 cost figures and must be resolved against the primary AM Best and ATRI reports before downstream use; (2) The 58,382 FMCSA falsification-violation count in PP3.3 is unverified against any primary government source and conflicts with CVSA's own published Roadcheck data — this figure anchors the 'second most-cited driver violation' claim in PP3.3 and needs primary FMCSA database verification; (3) PP3.5 (fleet maintenance) is almost entirely sourced from vendor marketing material (FleetRabbit blog, Fleetio benchmark report as vendor document) and scores Low across its cost and frequency claims. The top-5 deep-research targets address all three issues. The pain points framework and narrative analysis are analytically sound and well-structured; the source weaknesses are in specific quantitative claims, not the structural diagnosis.
